description: Two incompatible extensions of a finite word are both strictly longer than that word.
signature:
Lemmatheca.SetTheory.PerfectSubtrees.incompatible_strict_extensions {s u v : List ℕ} (hu : s <+: u) (hv : s <+: v)
  (h : Lemmatheca.SetTheory.PerfectSubtrees.Incompatible u v) : s.length < u.length ∧ s.length < v.length
